0022600215.text: The Orlando Magic (2-7, 0-4 on the road, on a four-game losing streak) visit the Sacramento Kings (1-9, 0-5 at home, on a three-game losing streak) in the 10th game of the Magic's season. Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), while Desmond Bane is day-to-day with an illness and is a game-time decision. Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), and Domantas Sabonis is day-to-day with knee soreness and is a game-time decision. The Magic swept the Kings 2-0 in the 2025-26 season, including a 121-117 win in Orlando on March 26, 2026, and the teams have not met yet this season.
